notes.title: [12/12] Post Patch Issues
notes.notes:
Dear NF2 Captains,

The following are issues that have been reported or noticed by our team following the recent Master Ship rewards system update:

[h1]1)[/h1] Players who have already completed all ship mastering steps save for the unlocking of the next ship in line will be paid as if they had completed all the steps.

However, no additional rewards will be placed once these players do complete the final step of unlocking the next respective ship in line.

ex)

If a player researched everything but the next ship in tier 5 before this patch, the player will receive 100 Gold reward following the patch, but will NOT get an additional 100 Gold after researching the next ship. 

If this same player researches the tier 6 ship completely, then 150 Gold will be placed.


[h1]2) [/h1]100 Gold was awarded for those who completed Tier 11,  but and additional 900 Gold should have been placed, the total reward for mastering tier 11 is 1000 Gold.

[h1]3)[/h1] Our team has been made aware of a possible bug that may be exploited following this patch. We will work to resolve this bug and any accounts that have intentionally abused this bug may be rolled back or have additional sanctions set on them as a result. 

[b][h1]Please do not abuse potential exploits as your account will be held accountable.[/h1][/b]

Our team apologizes for any inconvenience experienced as a result of these bugs. Your understanding is appreciated as we work to fully resolve them.

Thank you for your support,

NF2 Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: 08/12/2015
notes.notes:
Dear NF2 Captains,

All of the following updates are tentatively scheduled to be performed during this week's regularly scheduled maintenance period (barring any issues during final testing):

[h1][u][b]1. The Daily Mission System will be added.[/b][/u][/h1]

Our team has listened to your positive feedback regarding our event period daily missions as well as requests for additional rewards, resulting in the development of the Daily Mission System. This system will offer a number of varying challenges that can be completed for various rewards, all of which are offered directly in-game.

[img]http://s22.postimg.org/uqind9ny7/Mission_1.png[/img]

By clicking on the newly added "Mission" icon, players can bring up the Daily Mission panel in order to view the available daily missions and corresponding information.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/5hxtjlj0h/Mission_2.png[/img]

Once the mission panel has loaded, captains will be presented with the 4 daily missions of the day along with the following additional functions and details:

1) [b]Submissions/Mission Overview[/b]. A brief description of the mission along with the reward (usually in the form of credits) is shown here. Players are eligible to receive rewards upon completing missions on each respective captain account.

2) [b]Primary Mission[/b]. This is the main mission which will always provide a Reward box upon completion. Reward boxes contain a random Gold Box offering anywhere from 20 gold to 40 gold. Unlike normal missions, only one primary mission can be completed per "account" per day.

3) [b]Remaining time[/b]. A countdown showing the remaining time available to complete all of the daily missions. Once the countdown reaches 0, the missions will be reset and any incomplete progress including unclaimed rewards will be forfeited.

4) [b]Receive button[/b]. Players should click the receive button once a mission has been completed in order to claim rewards. Please do not forfeit any rewards by forgetting to claim them with the receive button.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/u9xfqu075/Mission_3.png[/img]

Once rewards are received, they will appear saved to your [b]Supply Depot[/b]. Please double check to make sure that you have sufficient space available in order to receive all of your rewards.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/rekcjyw75/Mission_4.png[/img]

Double-click all rewards located in your [b]Supply Depot[/b] to receive them on your account.

 

[h1][u][b]2. Ship balance adjustments will be made[/b][/u][/h1]

 
[u]The DP of CV class ships will be increased between that of CA and CL classes:[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/tj4apeoaz/Capture1.jpg[/img]


[u]The accuracy of high-angle BB will be increased by 5% (41 degree or above):[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/s7wjgxsp7/Capture2.jpg[/img]
 

[u]The accuracy of New Mexico will be decreased by 15%:[/u]

 
 [img]http://s23.postimg.org/ka24fafez/Capture3.jpg[/img]


[u]BB speeds will be decreased by 1 knot (Normal Speed):[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/79qdiusuj/Capture4.jpg[/img]

[u]CL aircraft space will be reduced:[/u]

 [img]http://s23.postimg.org/5tev0ppxn/Capture5.jpg[/img]

Our team will be performing tests leading up to patch period in order to make certain that these updates are fully ready. We will provide updates if there are any unforeseen issues and may delay the patch if deemed necessary.

 

Thank you for your continued support,

 

NF2 Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: Launch Preparations (12/08/14)
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1407NiA.jpg[/img]

Thank you for taking time to participate in the NF2 beta. Our team has been carefully going through all of the feedback received throughout the beta period. We intend to do all we can to satisfy our users and provide an enjoyable gameplay experience unlike any other.

With the beta period coming to an end on December 9th, we would like to share some information regarding what to expect in the initial stand-alone launch client, to be made available [url=www.navyfield2.com]December 11th[/url], along with upcoming plans. Please read on for all the details and stay tuned to the Navy Field 2 website and [url=www.facebook.com/navyfieldii]Facebook[/url] for details on Steam support progress!

[b]The following updates or changes have been tested and confirmed:[/b]

[h1]1) Manual key settings[/h1]

Key bindings will be changed to be near identical to the manual key settings of NF1. Veteran users may still feel a difference in control, but should be able to get accustomed quickly after a few battles.

Hot Keys will be fixed so they can be altered without issue.

[h1]2) Language filter[/h1]

The language filter will be fixed so only exact cases are flagged. This should resolve a number of captain name errors and will allow users to chat freely.

[h1]3) Miscellaneous graphical bugs and typos will be adjusted.[/h1]

[b]The following updates or changes require further testing but are confirmed for launch:[/b]

[h1]1) Revised Matching System[/h1]

[UPDATE] Our team has experienced some minor errors while recently testing the revised matching system. On account of these errors, we can no longer promise to have the system ready by Thursday (launch day), but will do all we can to make the patch cutoff. If we cannot provide the improved system as intended by launch, then it will be patched as soon as possible following. Thank you for your understanding on this.


Our current matching system initially tries to match up 2 similar teams (12vs12 and 16vs16 for example). Players who don't fit in to the balance have to wait until another team becomes available. This causes wait times that are far too long.

This system will be changed so that players who don't make the cutoff for the initial teams will then be set to battle immediately against each other. This may result in suboptimal battles, such as 5 vs 6, but players who participate in these battles will receive 20% additional EXP as compensation for the conditions. This will vastly improve wait times for individuals as well as shorten Platoon queues.

[h1]2) Fame System [/h1]

Fleets will be ranked each season. The Fame System will replace the tentative “Contribution System” as a method to assist players in being scouted by fleets. Players will gain a fame calculation when they participate in battle and achieve good scores.

This system will be solely dependent on the player's individual record, and will then be added to the fleet score once the player becomes a fleet member. With this, fleet leaders will have an incentive to scout good players to help enhance their overall fleet ranking.

[h1]3) Officer Slot System will be changed.[/h1]

There will no longer be any Premium Sailor exclusive slots. Sailors purchased with credit will be able to be loaded on any available slot. Prior to this change, sailors purchased with credits would only be able to be loaded on the currently designated “Basic Slots”.

With this change, players have the choice to devote their effort on utilizing credit sailors without feeling any pressure to make use of Premium Sailors if they don’t want to.

[h1]4) Battleship (BB) Auto FCS[/h1]

The auto reload will be slightly reduced as we felt that it has performed a bit faster than expected during beta.

[b]The following updates are being worked on, and will be patched shortly after initial launch:[/b]

[h1]1) Additional game modes[/h1]

[i]Annihilation mode – A basic battle mode with additional options.[/i]
Current mode– The default mode offered in beta
Allied vs Axis
Nation battle (e.g US vs IJN; UK vs KM)

[i]Occupation mode[/i]
Occupy all islands
Occupy the target island (just like Harbor Assault mode in NF1)

[i]Protection mode[/i]
Protect your commander’s ship mode
Protect your commander’s ship while you reach the target point (one team for defense; one team for offense.

[h1]2) Missions[/h1]

We will offer daily, weekly, and monthly missions. Players who complete these missions will receive item or Gold rewards.

[h1]3) EXP system[/h1]

Players will receive EXP when they occupy enemy or neutral bases. Players will also receive higher EXP when downing enemy aircraft with AA guns. This will provide a better incentive and tactical purpose for utilizing smaller ships in battle.

[h1]In addition to the listed changes, please expect many revisions and improvements to our website over the coming weeks. [/h1]

The most important note is that you please bear with us as we work to improve NF2 with your help and support. We realize that some aspects of the game may seem a bit alienating to veteran users or confusing for new players. With your help, we will work to develop our current foundation into an enjoyable experience for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
